inputs.name: acmd_i
inputs.note: M.2 — 3-bit acmd_e enum input (INS/RES/GEN/UPD/UNI). The idle-reachability property doesn't depend on which command type is dispatched — the FSM's path back to MainSmIdle is taken from every command-completion + every disable-while-running. Pinning to reset (3'h0 = invalid command → default branch routes to MainSmIdle) drops 3 input bits.

inputs.name: flag0_i
inputs.note: M.2 — flag bit for INS-with-flag0 differentiation; not relevant to idle-reachability.

properties.description: M.2 safety: `main_sm_err_o` is never asserted. `main_sm_err_o` is the 1-bit output equal to `state_q == MainSmError`. The FSM enters MainSmError only when `local_escalate_i` asserts; without that input, every reachable state from MainSmIdle stays in the 7 non-Error sparse FSM states. Expected verdict: `KleeneT` (or BoolDomain `true`) over the 7 non-Error states + initial state. Exercises R.3 KleeneDomain evaluator end-to-end on a real OpenTitan crypto-control FSM — §10.3 M.2 done-criterion (non-vacuous verdict on industrial fixture).
